stories.title: Exercise Tarang Shakti 2026 begins today at Jodhpur
stories.body: the second edition of the IAF's multinational air exercise runs 26 Sept–12 Oct 2026 at Air Force Station Jodhpur; seven foreign air forces take part (US, France, Germany, Australia, Bangladesh, Sri Lanka, UAE); the US F-35 fifth-generation fighter will exercise with the IAF for the first time (it had earlier only appeared at Aero India 2025); France brings 7 Rafales plus tankers and A400 transports, the UAE 6 F-16s, Bangladesh a C-130J; the IAF fields Rafale, Su-30MKI, Tejas, Mirage-2000, Jaguar, MiG-29 and 60+ assets; 32 nations attend as observers and ~10 air chiefs will visit; Vice Chief Air Marshal Ashutosh Dixit briefed the media. The maiden edition was held in 2024 at Sulur and Jodhpur.

stories.title: DRDO inks TDF pact with Zero mK India for 20 mK dilution refrigerator
stories.body: the first high-value deep-tech agreement under the Technology Development Fund (TDF) scheme: indigenous development of a 20 millikelvin dilution refrigerator for quantum computing, mentored by SSPL Director Dr Meena Mishra; supports the National Quantum Mission by cutting dependence on imported cryogenic infrastructure. TDF was approved in September 2016 under Make in India; the corpus was raised to ₹500 crore.

stories.title: PFRDA issues operational guidelines for NPS Swasthya
stories.body: under Section 14 of the PFRDA Act, 2013, PFRDA notified a new health-linked pension scheme combining retirement savings with healthcare benefits. Family-floater cover for subscriber, spouse and up to two dependent children (parents excluded); entry age 18–70, renewal to 85. Two components: an NPS Swasthya Investment Account and a Super Top-up. Minimum initial contribution is linked to the first-year insurance premium plus ₹200 annual maintenance for the Health Benefit Administrator plus taxes, and at least ₹1,000 to the investment account; minimum subsequent contribution ₹10. Four deductible/cover combos: ₹1 lakh (₹10,000 annual aggregate deductible), ₹5 lakh (₹50,000), ₹10 lakh (₹1 lakh), ₹30 lakh (₹3 lakh).

stories.title: RBI alters valuation norms for REITs and InvITs
stories.body: directions issued 22 Sept 2026, effective immediately, to remove ambiguity and ensure uniform valuation of InvIT/REIT units held by All-India Financial Institutions; apply to commercial banks, AIFIs, small finance banks, payment banks and local area banks. India's REIT market hit USD 17.7 billion, overtaking Hong Kong to become Asia's 4th largest.

stories.title: Samvriddhi Inclusive gets RBI in-principle approval to operate as PA-Online
stories.body: Samvriddhi Inclusive Growth Network Pvt. Ltd. (SIGN, a subsidiary of MOS Utility and a Kolkata-based corporate business correspondent working with PNB, BoB and SBI) will offer online payment aggregation to merchants, focused on small businesses in rural, semi-urban and underserved markets; the platform will support UPI, QR, credit/debit cards and net banking.

stories.title: PayGlocal gets IFSCA in-principle approval to set up a PSP in GIFT City
stories.body: the cross-border payments company (founded 2021, HQ Bengaluru) will set up a Payment Service Provider entity in GIFT City, Gandhinagar, for e-money account issuance, cross-border money transfers and merchant acquisition; it already holds RBI's final authorisation as a Payment Aggregator–Cross Border (inward + outward) and is registered as a Money Services Business with US FinCEN, supporting 130+ countries.

stories.title: SBI Card launches FD-backed secured credit cards on YONO
stories.body: the 'Advantage SBI Card' is fully digital: eligible customers can apply for an FD-backed secured credit card on the YONO app in ~10 minutes. Four variants: SBI Card ELITE, PRIME, SimplyCLICK and SimplySAVE; the FD acts as collateral and helps build a credit profile. Inaugurated by SBI Chairman Challa Sreenivasulu Setty with MD Ashwini Kumar Tewari and SBI Card MD & CEO Salila Pande.

stories.title: ADB raises India's FY27 GDP growth forecast to 7%
stories.body: in the Asian Development Outlook (September 2026), ADB raised its FY27 forecast by 40 bps from 6.6% to 7%, citing stronger-than-expected Q1 FY27 growth, robust investment, resilient consumption and solid manufacturing and services growth despite the West Asia crisis; FY28 projected at 7.1% (from 7.3%); inflation seen at 5.0% in FY27 (from 5.2%). This puts ADB alongside Fitch (6.9%), S&P, the OECD and others who raised India's FY27 forecasts to 6.9%–7.1% in September 2026.

stories.title: India's FY 2025-26 FDI inflow hits record USD 94.53 billion
stories.body: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal announced on 25 Sept that India recorded its highest-ever FDI inflow in FY 2025-26; cumulative FDI for FY 2014-15 to FY 2025-26 stood at USD 843 billion.

stories.title: NSC approves ₹320 crore SIP for Kurukshetra ITI Cluster under PM-SETU
stories.body: the National Steering Committee (MSDE) cleared the Strategic Investment Plan for the hub-and-spoke Kurukshetra ITI Cluster (7 government ITIs, Haryana) with Jindal Naveen Avsar Ltd as anchor industry partner for training, apprenticeships and employment; cumulative PM-SETU investment reaches ₹2,491 crore across 10 ITI clusters (a ₹240 crore Barbil, Odisha, cluster was also approved with the same anchor partner).

stories.title: UP CM launches 'Bharat Taxi' and 'Mukhyamantri Krishak Samriddhi Yojana'
stories.body: Bharat Taxi is a cooperative-based, zero-commission taxi service for two-wheeler, taxi and three-wheeler drivers with ₹5 lakh social security cover, starting in Lucknow, Gorakhpur, Varanasi and Prayagraj; MoUs signed with AAI, Lucknow Metro Rail and Lucknow Police. The Krishak Samriddhi Yojana cuts farm loan interest from 11% to 6% via the UP Cooperative Gramya Vikas Bank, including long-term loans for agriculture and farm machinery, targeting 5 lakh small and marginal farmers.

stories.title: ICAI issues SSA 5000 on sustainability assurance
stories.body: the Standard on Sustainability Assurance (SSA) 5000 — General Requirements & Framework for Sustainability Assurance Engagements — is a principle-based framework covering climate, labour practices and biodiversity, aligned with IAASB's ISSA 5000, with Indian carve-outs for joint audits and forward-looking statements; effective 1 April 2027, when SSAE 3000 and SAE 3410 will be withdrawn. ICAI was established on 1 July 1949, is HQ'd in New Delhi and headed by President CA Prasanna Kumar D.

stories.title: ISRO–ESA extend cooperation agreement to 8 January 2032
stories.body: through letters exchanged in Paris during the International Space Summit, the pact (in force since January 2002) is extended by 5 years and broadened to human and robotic exploration, space weather and sustainable outer-space activities, building on the 2025 Joint Statement of Intent on human exploration and the March 2026 Earth-observation agreement; signed by ISRO Chairman Dr V. Narayanan and ESA Director General Dr Josef Aschbacher.

stories.title: IIEST Shibpur and TCS launch Centre of Excellence in AI
stories.body: an MoU sets up the AI CoE at the HPC Lab of IIEST Shibpur's Electrical Engineering Department (West Bengal), with TCS as knowledge partner; focus on NLP, computer vision, image processing and data analytics, plus internships, innovation and AI startups, aligned with Digital India and Viksit Bharat 2047. TCS was established in 1968, is HQ'd in Mumbai and is headed by CEO & MD K. Krithivasan.

stories.title: IEA: India's electrification rate could rise from 19% to 32% by 2035
stories.body: the IEA's Electrification Special Report 2026 (prepared at the request of Türkiye and Australia for the COP31 strategic partnership) projects transport electrification and EV adoption could save India nearly 30% of its 2025 energy import bill; accelerated electrification could cut global energy import bills by over USD 400 billion by 2035; Southeast Asia could rise from 25% to 37%.

stories.title: OAG Megahubs 2026: Delhi Airport rises to 28th globally
stories.body: Delhi's IGIA jumped 11 places (39th → 28th) among the world's most-connected international airports; Istanbul (337 global destinations) is the most connected, followed by London Heathrow and Amsterdam Schiphol; Asia-Pacific holds 8 of the top 20; Kuala Lumpur topped the low-cost megahubs index, followed by Incheon and Istanbul Sabiha Gokcen.

stories.title: Mandeep K Bhandari appointed CBSE chairperson
stories.body: the ACC appointed the 2001-batch AGMUT IAS officer (serving as principal secretary to the J&K Lieutenant Governor, with additional charge as CEO of the Shri Amarnathji Shrine Board) as CBSE chairperson in the rank of additional secretary; he is the third chief in under four months, amid the controversy over the board's On-Screen Marking (OSM) system.

stories.title: Make in India completes 12 years
stories.body: PM Modi highlighted growth in manufacturing, electronics and defence production as the initiative marks the milestone.

stories.title: JPC begins scrutiny of the FCRA Amendment Bill, 2026
stories.body: the Joint Parliamentary Committee held its first meeting on 18 Sept 2026; the Bill's key provision makes all unutilised foreign contributions and assets created from them vest provisionally in a government-appointed Designated Authority when an FCRA certificate is cancelled, surrendered or lapses — permanent vesting if registration is not restored within the prescribed window, with proceeds from sale/transfer credited to the Consolidated Fund of India; appeals lie to the District Judge within 90 days, and the Bill adds deemed cessation and rationalises penalties (max jail term cut from 5 years to 1 year for specific violations). MHA told the JPC that 22,496 FCRA registrations have been cancelled since 2015, leaving 14,466 active, while foreign receipts rose to ₹22,974 crore in 2024-25; Opposition members invoked Article 300A against the asset-takeover clause.

stories.title: India–Netherlands tripartite MoUs on Gujarat's Kalpasar Project
stories.body: the Central Water Commission and the Kalpasar Department (Government of Gujarat) signed two MoUs with Netherlands-based Deltares and TU Delft for water-domain collaboration on the Kalpasar Project.

stories.title: India, France and UAE hold high-level talks
stories.body: cooperation on AI, space, energy and cultural exchanges.

stories.title: New plant species 'Begonia neelamorum' discovered in Arunachal Pradesh
stories.body: found along the Keyi River in Keyi Panyor district at ~1,000m elevation by Dipankar Borah, Madhusudhan Khanal, Momang Taram and Neelam Gap; published in the journal Taiwania. The 10–20 cm tuberous plant (single sessile light-green leaf, white male and female flowers) is named after the Neelam clan of the Nyishi community (locally Kobiirhopu Baabrai), provisionally classified as Data Deficient by the IUCN; it raises the Begonia count in Northeast India to 54 of ~2,200 globally.

stories.title: Mizoram farmer ZT Lalrithangi selected for FAO's '100 Women Heroes'
stories.body: the 35-year-old teacher-turned-farmer from Sangau village, Lawngtlai district (popularly Pi Mari-i), chosen for strawberry cultivation under the International Year of Women Farmers 2026 — among 100 women globally from 600+ nominations across 131 countries (2 from India), and the first Mizo to receive the honour; she will be felicitated at the World Food Forum in Rome, 12–16 Oct 2026.

stories.title: VP C.P. Radhakrishnan releases 'Vishwasanchar Hindutva Ka'
stories.body: the book, published by Saptahik Vivek, was released on 24 Sept at Uprashtrapati Bhawan, New Delhi; it coincides with the RSS centenary year (founded 1925 by Dr Keshav Baliram Hedgewar in Nagpur).

stories.title: Asian Games 2026 (Aichi-Nagoya): India win 2nd gold in shooting
stories.body: Kamaljeet and Suruchi Inder Singh topped the 10m air pistol mixed team final with 484.6 (South Korea 478.0, Iran bronze 415.8) after topping qualification with 587-29x; Aishwary Pratap Singh Tomar, Rudrankksh Patil and Niraj Kumar won silver in the men's 50m rifle 3-position team event (1762-94x, behind China).

stories.title: Kabaddi gold double bid today; athletics & TT medals on 25 Sept
stories.body: the women's team face Iran at 9:30 am IST and the men at 2:30 pm IST in the finals, after beating Nepal 48-24 and Thailand 66-28 in the semifinals. On 25 Sept: Gulveer Singh won silver in the men's 10,000m; Baranica Elangovan won bronze in the women's pole vault (India's first Asian Games pole-vault medal); Manpreet Kaur won bronze in the women's shot put; Manush Shah–Diya Chitale won bronze in table tennis mixed doubles; squash medals were assured by Anahat Singh, Abhay Singh and Joshna Chinappa–Velavan Senthilkumar.

stories.title: International Day for the Total Elimination of Nuclear Weapons — 26 September
stories.body: the UN observance, marked each year since 2014, follows UNGA resolution 68/32 of 2013 after the high-level meeting on nuclear disarmament held on 26 Sept 2013; it promotes education on the threat of nuclear weapons and the benefits of their elimination.

stories.title: World Environmental Health Day — 26 September
stories.body: highlights the link between environmental conditions and human health; also observed today: World Contraception Day (26 Sept) and the European Day of Languages (26 Sept).

stories.title: CSIR's 85th Foundation Day — 26 September 2026
stories.body: the Council of Scientific and Industrial Research was set up on 26 Sept 1942 as an autonomous body for scientific and industrial research; the CSIR Science & Innovation Quiz (SciQuiz) ran 20–26 Sept on the MY Bharat Portal with the Department of Youth Affairs.

stories.title: President returns West Bengal Public Safety Bill, 2026
stories.body: on 25 Sept President Droupadi Murmu returned the Bill (passed by the WB Assembly on 29 June 2026) for reconsideration: Sec 2(d)(iii)(B) brings NDPS Act offences into the Bill's "goonda" definition, risking parallel preventive detention with the PITNDPS Act, 1988 and raising Article 254 (doctrine of repugnancy, Concurrent List) concerns.

stories.title: MP launches 'Mukhyamantri Sugam Parivahan Seva'
stories.body: launched 25 Sept 2026 at BHEL Dussehra Ground, Bhopal by CM Dr. Mohan Yadav with Union Minister Nitin Gadkari (who also launched PM e-Bus Seva): 351 buses flagged off across 7 cities; target 1,500 buses in the first year and 15,000 by 2031 on a PPP model.

stories.title: Delhi PM Surya Ghar portal launched
stories.body: launched 21 Sept 2026 by CM Rekha Gupta (solar.delhi.gov.in) under PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana: combined subsidy of ₹1.56 lakh (₹78,000 Centre + ₹78,000 Delhi) for rooftop solar up to 3 kW; first phase targets 2.30 lakh families; consumers using up to 400 units/month get zero-upfront-cost installation.

stories.title: VP pays tribute to Pandit Deendayal Upadhyaya
stories.body: VP C.P. Radhakrishnan paid floral tributes on 25 Sept 2026, Upadhyaya's birth anniversary (born 25 Sept 1916), at Uprashtrapati Bhawan; PM Modi and Amit Shah also posted tributes. Antyodaya Diwas has been observed on his birthday since 2014.

stories.title: PM pays tribute to Dr. Manmohan Singh
stories.body: PM Modi posted a tribute on 26 Sept 2026, Singh's 94th birth anniversary (born 26 Sept 1932): India's 14th PM (2004–14), FM 1991–96 under Narasimha Rao, architect of the 1991 reforms and former RBI Governor.

stories.title: Centre slashes edible oil import duties
stories.body: effective 24 Sept 2026 (Notification 31/2026-Customs): crude sunflower oil BCD 10% → nil; crude palm and soybean oil 10% → 5%; refined soybean/palm 32.5% → 27.5%, refined sunflower 32.5% → 22.5%; the crude–refined duty differential is retained at 19.25% to protect domestic refining.

stories.title: Record defence production of ₹1.78 lakh crore in FY 2025-26
stories.body: up 15.6% YoY and 110% since 2020-21; defence exports hit a record ₹38,424 crore; announced by Raksha Mantri Rajnath Singh: DPSUs contribute ~76% and the private sector ~24% (~₹42,000 crore, an all-time high).

stories.title: India's first indigenous micro-GPU — IIT Delhi
stories.body: announced 24 Sept 2026 by the Electrical Engineering department: the first working, demonstrable indigenously designed micro-GPU from an Indian university, with the RTL design mapped to a Spartan-7 FPGA; led by M.Tech students Nammi Akash and M. Ravi Teja under Profs Jayadeva and Kaushik Saha; aimed at embedded display applications.

stories.title: Google's Project Suncatcher: first orbital test announced
stories.body: Sundar Pichai announced on 24 Sept 2026 that a Planet-built prototype carrying 4 Trillium TPUs will test AI compute in orbit, riding SpaceX Transporter-18 with a launch target of 1 Oct 2026; in-orbit solar yields ~8× more power than on Earth.

stories.title: RAPP-8 begins initial fuel loading
stories.body: NPCIL commenced Initial Fuel Loading at Unit-8 of the Rajasthan Atomic Power Project (Rawatbhata) at 15:18 hrs on 19 Sept 2026 after AERB permission: an indigenous 700 MWe PHWR, the 4th of the 16-unit fleet (KAPS-3/4 commercial in FY24, RAPP-7 in April 2025).

stories.title: TRAI launches Digital Connectivity Rating platform
stories.body: launched 25 Sept 2026 by Chairman Anil Kumar Lahoti: a voluntary platform + mobile app rating in-building mobile/internet connectivity of properties, with QR-verified certificates; under the TRAI (Rating of Properties for Digital Connectivity) Regulations, 2024 (amended 13 May 2026) and the Rating Manual 2026 (9 June 2026); 23 accredited rating agencies at launch.

stories.title: Jaishankar signs UN Convention against Cybercrime
stories.body: EAM S. Jaishankar signed on 25 Sept 2026 on the sidelines of UNGA81 in New York: the first comprehensive global treaty on cybercrime (adopted by UNGA in Dec 2024, entered into force after 40 signatures, ~91–93 signatories), aimed at prevention, suppression and exchange of electronic evidence.

stories.title: Oxford Economics Global Cities Index 2026
stories.body: ranks 1,000 cities across Economics, Human Capital, Quality of Life, Environment and Governance: Delhi is 268th (best-ranked Indian city), Bengaluru 311th, Mumbai 330th; New York tops the index.

stories.title: Gulbarga Tur Dal exported to the Maldives
stories.body: on 24 Sept 2026 APEDA flagged off a 1 MT sea consignment from Karnataka to the Maldives by Mysuru-based Silken Global Exports & Imports (an FPO-led brand); farmers get ₹82/kg versus ₹60 market price (>30% higher). Gulbarga Tur Dal got GI registration in 2019 (Kalaburagi region, Karnataka).

stories.title: Rajnath Singh felicitates 20-peak Ladakh team
stories.body: flag-in ceremony on 25 Sept 2026 at Kartavya Bhavan-2, New Delhi for the 20-member NIMAS (Dirang) team led by Col Ranveer Singh Jamwal, which made first recorded ascents of 20 previously unclimbed peaks above 6,000 m in the Ladakh Range in 23 days.

stories.title: Asian Games: Sawan Barwal's marathon silver (national record)
stories.body: on 26 Sept Barwal clocked 2:11:37 (national record) for silver behind Japan's Ichitaka Yamashita (2:10:49), China's Peiyou Feng taking bronze; India's first Asian Games marathon medal since 1982 (44 years), and the first ever won outside India. The 28-year-old Havildar in the Indian Army from Himachal Pradesh had set the previous record (2:11:58) at Rotterdam in April 2026.

stories.title: Asian Games: women's kabaddi team win GOLD
stories.body: India's 3rd gold of the Games, beating Iran in the final; Indian women have won kabaddi gold at every Asian Games since the women's event began in 2010.

stories.title: Asian Games 26 Sept: more medals
stories.body: the women's 50m rifle 3-position team of Tilottama Sen, Vidarsa K. Vinod and Ashi Chouksey won silver (1,763 pts, behind China at 1,773); Joshna Chinappa and Velavan Senthilkumar won bronze in squash mixed doubles.

one_liners: Tarang Shakti 2026: 2nd edition, begins 26 Sept at Jodhpur (till 12 Oct); 7 foreign air forces; F-35 exercises with the IAF for the first time; France — 7 Rafales; UAE — 6 F-16s; Bangladesh — C-130J.

DRDO TDF: first high-value deep-tech pact with Zero mK India for a 20 mK dilution refrigerator for quantum computing; TDF scheme approved Sept 2016; ₹500 crore corpus; mentored by SSPL Director Dr Meena Mishra.

NPS Swasthya: PFRDA guidelines under Section 14 of the PFRDA Act, 2013; family floater = subscriber + spouse + 2 dependent children (parents excluded); entry 18–70, renewal to 85; min initial ₹1,000 investment; min subsequent contribution ₹10; cover combos ₹1L/₹5L/₹10L/₹30L with ₹10k/₹50k/₹1L/₹3L deductibles.
RBI: revised valuation norms for REIT/InvIT units held by AIFIs (directions of 22 Sept, immediate effect); India REIT market USD 17.7 bn — Asia's 4th largest, overtakes Hong Kong.
SIGN: RBI in-principle approval as PA-Online; MOS Utility subsidiary; Kolkata-based business correspondent; targets rural/semi-urban small merchants.
PayGlocal: IFSCA in-principle approval for a PSP in GIFT City; already holds RBI PA-CB (inward + outward) final authorisation + US FinCEN MSB registration; 130+ countries; founded 2021.
SBI Card: 'Advantage SBI Card' — FD-backed secured credit cards on YONO; 4 variants (ELITE, PRIME, SimplyCLICK, SimplySAVE); apply in ~10 min.
ADB: India's FY27 GDP forecast raised to 7% (from 6.6%); Asian Development Outlook, Sept 2026; FY28 at 7.1%; inflation 5.0% FY27.
FDI: record USD 94.53 bn in FY 2025-26 (Goyal, 25 Sept); cumulative FY15–FY26 USD 843 bn.
PM-SETU: ₹320 crore SIP for Kurukshetra ITI Cluster (7 govt ITIs, Haryana); anchor — Jindal Naveen Avsar Ltd; cumulative ₹2,491 cr across 10 clusters.

UP: Bharat Taxi — cooperative, zero-commission, ₹5 lakh social security cover; starts in Lucknow, Gorakhpur, Varanasi, Prayagraj; Mukhyamantri Krishak Samriddhi Yojana — farm loans at 6% (from 11%), target 5 lakh farmers.
ICAI SSA 5000: sustainability assurance standard aligned with IAASB ISSA 5000; effective 1 April 2027; SSAE 3000 & SAE 3410 withdrawn from April 2027.

ISRO–ESA: cooperation agreement extended to 8 Jan 2032 (signed Paris, International Space Summit); adds human & robotic exploration, space weather, sustainability of outer space; in force since Jan 2002.
IIEST Shibpur–TCS AI Centre of Excellence: venue — HPC Lab (Electrical Engineering dept); TCS knowledge partner; NLP, computer vision, image processing, data analytics.
IEA: India's electrification rate 19% → 32% by 2035; India could save ~30% of 2025 energy import bill; global savings over USD 400 bn by 2035.
OAG Megahubs 2026: Delhi IGIA jumps 39th → 28th; Istanbul most connected (337 destinations); Heathrow 2nd, Schiphol 3rd; Asia-Pacific holds 8 of top 20.
CBSE: Mandeep K Bhandari (IAS, 2001, AGMUT) appointed chairperson — 3rd chief in 4 months; appointed as Additional Secretary rank amid the OSM row.
Make in India: 12 years completed.

FCRA Amendment Bill 2026: JPC first meeting 18 Sept; designated authority takes provisional vesting of unutilised foreign contributions + assets on cancellation/surrender/lapse; permanent if not restored; sale proceeds to Consolidated Fund of India; appeal to District Judge within 90 days; 22,496 registrations cancelled since 2015, 14,466 active.
India–Netherlands: two tripartite MoUs on Kalpasar Project (Gujarat) — CWC + Kalpasar Dept with Deltares & TU Delft.
Begonia neelamorum: new species from Keyi Panyor, Arunachal Pradesh; named after the Neelam clan (Nyishi); published in Taiwania; IUCN — Data Deficient; NE India Begonia count now 54.

FAO award: ZT Lalrithangi (Pi Mari-i), Mizoram — 100 Women Heroes in Agrifood Systems; strawberry cultivation; honoured at World Food Forum, Rome (12–16 Oct 2026); International Year of Women Farmers 2026.
Book: VP C.P. Radhakrishnan released 'Vishwasanchar Hindutva Ka' (Saptahik Vivek), 24 Sept; RSS centenary (founded 1925, K.B. Hedgewar, Nagpur).
Asian Games shooting: 2nd gold — Kamaljeet & Suruchi Inder Singh, 10m air pistol mixed team (484.6); rifle 3P team silver (Tomar, Rudrankksh Patil, Niraj Kumar; 1762-94x).
Kabaddi: women vs Iran 9:30 am IST, men vs Iran 2:30 pm IST (26 Sept); semis — women beat Nepal 48-24, men beat Thailand 66-28.

Athletics Day 7 (25 Sept): Gulveer Singh silver (men's 10,000m); Baranica Elangovan bronze (women's pole vault — India's first pole-vault medal); Manpreet Kaur bronze (women's shot put); TT mixed doubles bronze (Manush Shah–Diya Chitale).

Important days 26 Sept: International Day for the Total Elimination of Nuclear Weapons (UN, since 2014, UNGA resolution 68/32); World Environmental Health Day; World Contraception Day; European Day of Languages.
